Title: Public preview: gMSAv2 security policy support for Kubernetes workloads on Windows

Body.Content:
gMSAv2 is a secure mechanism to provide Active Directory authentication mechanism to Kubernetes workloads on Windows without having to use Machine Accounts and joining your AKS nodes to an Active Directory. 

Learn more.
